description: A 12-week DSA plan in pattern dependency order: 236 Tier A problems at 3-5 a day, a daily time budget with revision first, mock-round weeks 5, 9 and 12, and a 4-week crash variant.

Level 2 - Beginner 40 min Start here Study plan Mock rounds

12-week plan from zero to interview-ready

A week-by-week order of patterns, with a fixed number of new problems each day drawn from the Dojo Curated 450 (Tier A), three mock-round weeks, a daily time budget that leaves room for revision, and a 4-week crash version for when the interview is already booked.
